mapper.select: SELECT bc.bom_component_id, bc.material_item_id, bc.material_unit_code AS unit_code, i.item_code AS material_code, i.item_name AS material_name, bc.required_qty, v.base_qty, w.ordered_qty, (SELECT SUM(bc2.required_qty) FROM bom_component bc2 WHERE bc2.bom_version_id=bc.bom_version_id AND bc2.material_item_id=bc.material_item_id AND bc2.material_unit_code=bc.material_unit_code) AS material_required_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.consumed_qty),0) FROM material_consumption c JOIN raw_material_lot l ON l.raw_lot_id=c.raw_lot_id WHERE c.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.item_id=bc.material_item_id AND l.unit_code=bc.material_unit_code) AS consumed_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.returned_qty),0) FROM material_return r JOIN material_consumption c ON c.consumption_id=r.consumption_id JOIN raw_material_lot l ON l.raw_lot_id=c.raw_lot_id WHERE c.work_order_id=w.work_order_id AND l.item_id=bc.material_item_id AND l.unit_code=bc.material_unit_code) AS returned_qty FROM work_order w JOIN bom_version v ON v.bom_version_id=w.bom_version_id JOIN bom_component bc ON bc.bom_version_id=v.bom_version_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id=bc.material_item_id WHERE w.work_order_id=#{workOrderId} ORDER BY bc.line_no

SELECT l.raw_lot_id, l.item_id, l.lot_no, l.unit_code, l.available_qty, i.item_code, i.item_name FROM work_order w JOIN bom_component bc ON bc.bom_version_id=w.bom_version_id JOIN raw_material_lot l ON l.item_id=bc.material_item_id AND l.unit_code=bc.material_unit_code JOIN item i ON i.item_id=l.item_id WHERE w.work_order_id=#{workOrderId} AND bc.bom_component_id=#{bomComponentId} ORDER BY l.raw_lot_id DESC
SELECT raw_lot_id, item_id, unit_code, available_qty, registered_qty FROM raw_material_lot WHERE raw_lot_id=#{rawLotId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE raw_material_lot SET available_qty=available_qty-#{quantity}, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE raw_lot_id=#{rawLotId} AND available_qty >= #{quantity} AND #{quantity} > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_consumption (work_order_id, raw_lot_id, bom_component_id, receipt_id, consumed_qty, consumed_at, created_by) VALUES (#{workOrderId}, #{rawLotId}, #{bomComponentId}, #{receiptId}, #{consumedQty}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO request_receipt (scope_key, operation_code, request_key, payload_fingerprint, created_by) VALUES (#{scopeKey}, 'MATERIAL_CONSUME', #{requestKey}, #{payloadFingerprint}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT receipt_id, scope_key, operation_code, request_key, payload_fingerprint, initial_outcome_snapshot AS snapshot, processed_at, created_by FROM request_receipt WHERE scope_key=#{scopeKey} AND operation_code='MATERIAL_CONSUME' AND request_key=#{requestKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE request_receipt SET initial_outcome_snapshot=#{snapshot}, processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId} AND operation_code='MATERIAL_CONSUME' AND processed_at IS NULL AND initial_outcome_snapshot IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_consumption WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_return WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM production_result WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quality_inspection WHERE receipt_id=#{receiptId})
